youtube_description:
After a trip to the fish store with some advise from a friends , i tested my phosphates . They were way to high , and this is how i deal with it so far.
=======================
37 gallon  with LED hood
6 pristella tetra's
6 white cloud's
3 rosey barb's
6 rummy nose tetra's
1  bristle nose pleco
2 corydoras sodalis (false network)
1 corydoras leucomelas ( blackfin )
Hydrosponge III :  driven with air pump 
Penguin 200 with hand- made filters :  
Stage 1/2 : ammonia pad with ATI activated filter carbon 
Stage 3/4 :blue bonded filter pad with Fluval Clearmax
